items.title: Treasury will not commit to reducing welfare bill before next election
items.summary: The Treasury is disputing that the chancellor suggested to the BBC the benefits bill will be cut before the next election.

items.title: Suppliers threaten to cut ties with Poundland as chain nears collapse
items.summary: Major suppliers are moving to cut ties with Poundland as the discount chain lurches towards an insolvency process which threatens to unleash thousands of job losses.

items.title: I earn £30,000. I'm angry there was no fuel duty cut in the Budget
items.summary: People on a range of incomes from £4,062 to £150,000 a year tell the BBC what they made of this year's Budget.

items.title: Defiant Bolsonaro breaks silence after fleeing Brazil for the US
items.summary: Flavio Bolsonaro has called himself the "leader of Brazil" - despite losing the presidential election.

items.title: Poundland's future hangs in the balance as chain edges towards collapse
items.summary: Poundland's bosses is filing a notice of intention to appoint administrators to the business.

items.title: Social media watchdog sets out age verification plans ahead of under-16s ban
items.summary: Social media age checks could help protect under-16s from inappropriate online content, but some children may find ways round them, Ofcom has said.
